title: minirepo
summary: This repository provides a modular framework for building applications, demonstrating key functionalities like external API integration, core workflow orchestration, data management, and system observability. It serves as a foundational example for developers to understand and implement structured application components. The system allows users to initiate processes, interact with external services, handle data persistence, and monitor application health.

nodes.label: Developer / Operator
nodes.title: Application User
nodes.description: Interacts with the system to initiate workflows, configure settings, and monitor operations, serving as the primary human interface.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Main Application Logic
nodes.title: Core Workflow Engine
nodes.description: Manages the primary application flow, including configuration, data batch initialization, and execution of data processing pipelines to achieve business goals.

nodes.label: Integrate External APIs
nodes.title: External API Connector
nodes.description: Provides a unified interface for communicating with external application servers, handling configuration, health checks, and data retrieval for seamless integration.

nodes.label: Manage Data I/O
nodes.title: Data Handling & Storage
nodes.description: Handles file input/output operations, supporting various formats like JSON and CSV for temporary data persistence and retrieval within the application.

nodes.label: Monitor System Metrics
nodes.title: System Monitoring & Logging
nodes.description: Collects and logs critical system-level metrics, such as event counters and queue depths, to ensure comprehensive application observability and performance tracking.

groups.label: User Interaction
groups.title: User & Developer
groups.description: The human actor interacting with the system to initiate processes, configure settings, and review outcomes.

groups.label: Core Application Services
groups.title: Core Application Services
groups.description: The central components responsible for orchestrating main application logic and integrating with external systems to deliver core functionality.

groups.label: Support & Utility Services
groups.title: Support & Utility Services
groups.description: Provides essential functionalities like data persistence, file handling, and comprehensive system monitoring and logging for operational insights.
